WHEREAS, TREUTLEN County (the “County”) has considered establishing a Deferred Compensation Plan (the “Plan”) pursuant to section 457 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”) to be made available to all eligible County employees and independent contractors who perform services for the County; and

WHEREAS, certain income tax benefits are available to those eligible individuals who elect to participate in the Plan by voluntarily electing to set aside and invest a portion of their current income from the County in order to supplement future retirement income; and

WHEREAS, by adopting the ACCG 457 Deferred Compensation Program, the County will delegate certain administrative responsibilities to ACCG or its designee to administer the Plan. NOW THEREFORE, THE COUNTY HEREBY RESOLVES AS FOLLOWS:

RESOLVED, that the County governing body, at a meeting held on the 6th_ day of

MARCH, 2001 , RARX hereby adopts the ACCG 457 Deferred Compensation Program and establishes the TREUTLEN County 457 Deferred Compensation Plan for the voluntary participation of all eligible employees who perform services for the County.

FURTHER RESOLVED, the County hereby designates ACCG (or its designee) to administer the Plan.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that GEORGE L. McLENDON is hereby authorized by the County to execute the Plan document, Administrative Services Agreement, Trust Agreement and any other documents necessary to implement the Plan, and to take all further actions necessary to carry out the intent and purposes of the foregoing resolutions.

IT IS HEREBY FURTHER ORDERED that a true copy of these resolutions be recorded in the County’s records as of this date. TREUTLEN COUNTY BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS
